component.name: Gosh Yubico Authenticator
component.summary: Manage OATH credentials on YubiKey devices

description.p: Gosh Yubico Authenticator is a native GTK 4 / Adwaita desktop application for managing OATH (TOTP and HOTP) credentials stored on YubiKey devices.
This independent application is not affiliated with or endorsed by Yubico.

ul.li: Generate TOTP and HOTP codes from credentials on the key
Add credentials from a secret or by scanning a QR image
Protect the key with an OATH PIN and require touch when needed
Copy codes to the clipboard with automatic clearing
Follow the system theme, or force light or dark

description.p: The Flatpak talks to the host PC/SC daemon. Install and start pcscd on the host before inserting a YubiKey.
Fail closed on malformed OATH device identity data and tighten Flatpak permissions.
Native GTK 4 / Adwaita rewrite with Flatpak packaging.
